title: Deterministic escape hatch bypass
description: Implement ADR-0004 as code: an owner-reviewed must-never-miss list (host gone dark, backups dead) checked before triage and notified unconditionally, without the model deciding anything. Today the only enforcement point is a regex over src/prompts/triage.md, which pins prose rather than behavior. The list stays short and its contents are an owner decision.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

commits.message: feat(escape-hatch): deterministic bypass mechanism with empty owner list
